messages:
jordan: Hey folks — quick onboarding Qs about benefits/payroll. I'm seeing my medical insurance effective date in the portal as 3/1 but my start date was 2/15. Will deductions be retroactively taken? Also I submitted my W-4 in Rippling but haven't seen confirmation. How do I split direct deposit across accounts? And is PTO/holiday accrual prorated for a mid-month start? Thanks!

claire (People Ops): Hi Jordan — congrats and welcome! Short answers: coverage effective date defaults to the first of the month after your start unless your offer says otherwise. We can request retroactive coverage enrollment (and payroll retro deductions) but we need the offer + a screenshot from the benefits portal. Can you DM those to me?

claire (People Ops): W-4s — if you completed via Rippling, there should be a confirmation email. If you uploaded a PDF, send it here or to payroll@redwood.com and @andre will confirm.

claire (People Ops): Direct deposit split — we use the Direct Deposit Authorization form. You can split by % or fixed $ but payroll recommends a fixed $ for secondary accounts to avoid rounding. Cutoff to change for the upcoming pay cycle is the 25th of the month.

claire (People Ops): PTO/holidays — first partial month is prorated for accrual. Holiday pay eligibility requires you to be on payroll on the holiday date. Pasting the quick policy snippet:
```
PTO accrual: pro rata for partial first month (monthly accrual * days employed / days in month)
Holiday pay: employee must be active on payroll on the holiday date to receive holiday pay
Enrollment window: new hires have 30 days to make benefits elections
```

andre (Payroll): @claire @jordan Quick clarifications from payroll side: if benefits admin needs retro premium collections, payroll can apply retro deductions on the next pay run. If the amount is large we can split it across 2 runs — we usually try to avoid >2 cycles.

andre (Payroll): W-4 status — Jordan, if you paste the Rippling confirmation email or a screenshot I will verify and confirm the tax withholding setup.

andre (Payroll): Direct deposit form link (internal): https://intranet.redwood/payroll/dd-form — submit + attach a voided check or bank letter. If we receive it before the 25th cut-off, change applies to the next cycle; otherwise it starts the cycle after.

sophie (Finance): Re: splitting deposit — we also offer a one-time manual transfer if you prefer that for this cycle (that avoids changing schedules). DM me the amount and last 4 of acct and I can route it. :slightly_smiling_face:

jordan: Uploaded W-4 in Rippling about 2 minutes ago, didn't get a confirmation email though. DMing offer letter + screenshot of benefits portal now. Appreciate the quick help. :pray:

claire (People Ops): Got the docs, thanks. I'll open a retro request and loop in payroll. @people-ops-bot will create the ticket.

people-ops-bot: New retro coverage request created (#BR-2932) — assigned to claire (People Ops). Payroll has been notified. Estimated resolution: 3 business days.

andre (Payroll): Thanks — I'll watch for #BR-2932 and ping once the deduction/retro plan is scheduled.

claire (People Ops): Jordan — once payroll confirms the W-4 and we get the retro processed we'll update you here. If you need the direct deposit changed this cycle, DM @sophie immediately with the $ amount. :thumbsup:
